subject.title: [Bug]: diagnostics-otel reuses a signal-qualified OTLP endpoint for all enabled signals, POSTing metrics/logs to the traces endpoint

question: Should maintainers accept shared-endpoint per-signal normalization and choose `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101655` or `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98911` as the canonical landing PR?
rationale: The source bug is clear and the fix direction matches the OTLP shared-endpoint contract, but accepting it changes a shipped fallback behavior and requires choosing between duplicate open PRs.

options.title: Land the active proven PR
options.body: Treat `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101655` as canonical if its proof remains current and maintainers accept the shared-endpoint compatibility change.

options.title: Revive the older candidate
options.body: Ask for `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98911` to be rebased and used as the canonical landing path instead.

options.title: Preserve exact shared URL reuse
options.body: Request a redesigned fix that warns or skips mismatched shared signal paths while keeping exact shared URL reuse as the default.

recommendation.title: Land the active proven PR
recommendation.body: Treat `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101655` as canonical if its proof remains current and maintainers accept the shared-endpoint compatibility change.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current endpoint preservation behavior and is assigned to the active compatibility-sensitive candidate PR.
